discovery: The gauge/gravity (AdS/CFT) correspondence: the holographic equivalence between quantum gravity in anti-de Sitter space and strongly coupled gauge theory

nominees.name: Juan Maldacena
nominees.affiliation: Institute for Advanced Study, Princeton, USA

nominees.name: Edward Witten
nominees.affiliation: Institute for Advanced Study, Princeton, USA

subfield: High-energy theory / quantum gravity and quantum field theory
motivation: Maldacena's 1997 conjecture that string theory in anti-de Sitter space is exactly equivalent to a conformal gauge theory on its boundary, made precise by Witten and by Gubser, Klebanov and Polyakov through the holographic dictionary, is the most consequential idea in theoretical physics of the past three decades. Building on Polyakov's long programme relating gauge fields to strings, it gives a non-perturbative definition of quantum gravity and makes black hole thermodynamics a statement about ordinary quantum many-body systems. Its predictions have been checked by exact computations, including superconformal indices and localization, which now reproduce the Bekenstein-Hawking entropy of AdS black holes microscopically. Holography also gave quantitative tools for strongly coupled matter, such as the near-minimal shear viscosity of the quark-gluon plasma seen at RHIC and the LHC, and reshaped the study of quantum information, chaos and the black hole information problem.
